# Vendor note: Northwind Data Labeling

- Service: human data labeling for text classification, 3 languages (EN, FR, DE).
- Pricing: 0.11 EUR per labeled item, 0.18 EUR with double annotation; minimum order
  20,000 items per quarter.
- Term: 6 months, then month to month.
- Termination: 30 days notice; unused prepaid credits refunded at 80%.
- Quality: inter-annotator agreement reported per batch; re-labeling free if agreement
  falls under 0.75.
- Risks: annotators are subcontracted in two countries; no ISO 27001 certification yet
  (planned for next year); turnaround can slip to 10 days in peak periods.
